results.criterion: must: each toggle's state is shown as a word (on / off), not as a switch, slider or pill control
results.seen: The state is now the words 'on' and 'off', but both sit inside an outlined pill with 'on' filled ink: a two-segment pill switch, not a bare word.
results.fix: Drop the pill outline and fill: print the state as plain text ('on' or '[on] off') at the row's right edge.

results.criterion: must: the state words line up in one column on the right, like the values of a menu
results.seen: The four on/off controls are right-aligned at the same x on every toggle row, forming one column.
results.fix: None needed; keep the alignment when the pill is removed.

results.criterion: must: the current (hovered or focused) row is marked by one solid colour band across the whole row
results.seen: Both screenshots show the popup at rest with no row hovered or focused; no band is visible. A screenshot with a toggle row hovered or keyboard-focused is missing.
results.fix: Supply a screenshot with one toggle row hovered/focused; that row should carry a full-width solid ink or rose band with reversed text.

results.criterion: must: the toggles read as a plain list of text rows, not rows inside a rounded card
results.seen: The four toggles are still inside a white (light) / dark-grey (dark) rounded grouped card with hairline separators, the same structure as today.
results.fix: Remove the card background, radius and separators for the toggle group; set the rows as bare text lines on the page background.

results.criterion: must_not: a switch or pill-shaped control on any toggle row
results.seen: Every toggle row ends in a rounded pill outline holding 'on' (ink-filled capsule) and 'off': a pill-shaped control.
results.fix: Remove the pill border and capsule fill from .toggle; leave only the state word(s).

results.seen: The iOS green switches are gone and the toggles are ink/grey only; no system blue anywhere on the toggles.

results.criterion: must: refuse / accept / leave is one outlined pill with the chosen side filled in ink and its text reversed
results.seen: One thin-outlined pill; 'refuse' is a filled ink capsule with white text in light mode (light capsule with dark text in dark mode).

results.criterion: must: the unchosen sides are plain text on the background
results.seen: 'accept' and 'leave' are grey text directly on the card background, no track fill.

results.criterion: must_not: a grey track with a white raised thumb
results.seen: Today's grey track and white raised thumb are gone; the track is the card background inside an outline.
No blue in the segmented control (or in the report link, which was blue today).

results.criterion: must: when a banner was handled, the main status line names the handled thing struck through, at full text size
results.seen: The status line reads '~~cookie banner~~ refused': 'cookie banner' is struck through at the same size, but set in muted grey while the unstruck 'refused' in full ink carries the line.
results.fix: Make the struck 'cookie banner' the line itself, in full ink at full contrast; drop 'refused' or move it to the small sub-line.

results.criterion: must: the handled row is set apart as a filled row (a colour field), the way done items are in the reference
results.seen: The handled row sits in the same white/dark-grey card as every other group, led by a small green dot; no colour field marks it.
results.fix: Fill the handled status row edge to edge with one flat colour (e.g. rose) behind the struck text, and drop the dot.

results.criterion: must_not: the strike only on a small grey prefix while the line is carried by an unstruck word
results.seen: The strike is on a grey 'cookie banner' prefix and the line is carried by the unstruck, darker 'refused': the pattern this rules out, only the prefix is not smaller.
results.fix: Put the strike on the word that carries the line, in full ink; no unstruck verdict word competing with it.

results.criterion: must: one thing is at full contrast (this page's status); the rest of the popup is visibly quieter
results.seen: The toggle labels, the four ink-filled 'on' capsules, the ink 'refuse' capsule and the report/settings rows are all at full contrast; the status line is no louder than them, and its struck part is greyed down.
results.fix: Set toggles, site choice and report/settings in the muted colour (or lighter weight) and keep only the this-page status at full ink.

results.criterion: must_not: several accents competing at full strength (coloured dots, filled pills, ink buttons)
results.seen: Five ink-filled capsules (four 'on', one 'refuse'), a green status dot and the rose logo all appear at full strength at once.
results.fix: Remove the filled 'on' capsules and the green dot; leave at most one filled accent (the chosen site option) besides the status.

results.criterion: must: text is set in Martian Mono
results.seen: All popup text renders in a squarish geometric mono with Martian Mono's letterforms, replacing today's ui-monospace; the font is bundled (extension/fonts/martian-mono-*.woff2).

results.criterion: must: Martian Mono at its natural width; the layout makes room for it
results.seen: The glyphs are visibly narrower than Martian Mono's natural wide setting so rows fit today's widths; popup.html sets font-stretch: 81% on body.
results.fix: Remove font-stretch: 81% (use 100%) and widen the popup or wrap/shorten labels so rows fit.

results.criterion: must_not: the typeface condensed (font-stretch below 100%) to fit today's rows
results.seen: Body text is condensed (font-stretch: 81% in extension/popup/popup.html line 34), visibly narrow in both screenshots.
results.fix: Set font-stretch to 100% and let the layout grow.

extra: Toggle rows use the B/W segmented-pill look (11379889, picked for the site choice) as on/off switches: a reference applied to a different element, and it keeps a pill control where 19335916 wants plain words.
Today's rounded grouped cards with hairline separators are kept for every group (toggles, status, site choice, report/settings); only colours and type changed.
This-page status keeps today's 'dot + sentence' structure (now a green dot), the thing 20770715 replaces.
Thin outlined 'on|off' capsules repeat on four rows plus the site choice, adding five filled accents where 2092684 asks for one.
